chars.h1: a gangly young human recruit, about eighteen, with messy copper-red hair and a long thin face, bareheaded, in a plain quilted tunic
chars.h2: an old human veteran in his sixties, bald, with a thick white walrus mustache and heavy jowls, in a plain leather jerkin
chars.h3: a huge heavyset human brute with a shaved head, a thick square black beard, a broken flat nose and a bull neck, in a plain leather vest
chars.h4: a lean human woman scout in her late twenties with a tight dark braid over one shoulder, sharp cheekbones and a scar across her lip, her cloak hood pushed back
chars.h5: a dark-skinned human spearman in his thirties with short tight curly black hair, a wide nose and a small gold earring, in a plain padded jacket
chars.h6: a gaunt human sergeant in his forties with sunken cheeks, a hooked nose and narrow eyes, wearing a simple bowl-shaped steel cap
chars.h7: a broad-faced human knight-captain with long blond hair and a braided blond beard, wearing an open-faced steel helmet with a nose guard
chars.h8: a wiry human mercenary with a tall black mohawk, a notched ear and a long chin, in a sleeveless leather jerkin
chars.h9: a round-faced pudgy human quartermaster with a double chin, small eyes and a wide-brimmed felt hat
